# Pull Request #3967: fix(react): stabilize composed ref identities to end React 19 render loop (#3963)

State: MERGED
Draft: false
Author: @nakisgr
Base: main
Head: fix/composed-ref-stability-react19
Merge state: UNKNOWN
Created: 2026-06-15T19:57:17Z
Updated: 2026-06-15T21:43:34Z
URL: https://github.com/radix-ui/primitives/pull/3967

## Body

## Summary

Follows up on #3899, which stabilized Slot's composed ref to fix the React 19 infinite re-render loop. The same unstable-identity pattern still exists in several other packages' own code, and under React 19's ref-cleanup semantics each reproduces the same `Maximum update depth exceeded` crash.

`useComposedRefs` is `React.useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs)`. When a member of `refs` is an inline arrow (or the composition is a bare `composeRefs(...)` in render), the composed callback gets a new identity every render. React 19 detaches/re-attaches the ref on every commit; any composed state-setter ref toggles `null -> node` each cycle, scheduling another render — an infinite loop.

## Changes

Same principle as #3899 — give the composed refs a stable identity:

- **Pass state setters directly** (`useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, setX)`), matching existing usage like `select.tsx` `onTriggerChange`:
  - `react-dismissable-layer`: `DismissableLayer` → `setNode`
  - `react-focus-scope`: `FocusScope` → `setContainer`
  - `react-popper`: `PopperContent` → `setContent`
  - `react-scroll-area`: `ScrollArea` → `setScrollArea`, `Scrollbar` → `setScrollbar`, `Thumb` → `scrollbarContext.onThumbChange` (already stabilized via `useCallbackRef`)
  - `react-select`: `SelectContentImpl` / `SelectItemAlignedPosition` → `setContent`, `SelectItemText` → `setItemTextNode`
- **Hoist render-inline `composeRefs(...)` into `useComposedRefs`** above the JSX:
  - `react-dropdown-menu`: `DropdownMenuTrigger`
  - `react-menu`: `MenuSubTrigger` (composed directly with the `onTriggerChange` state setter)
- **Wrap closures that capture per-render values in `useCallbackRef`** before composing (they take extra args, so can't be passed directly):
  - `react-select`: `SelectItem` (`value`, `disabled`) and `SelectItemText` (`value`, `disabled`)

## Notes

- Changes are mechanical and behavior-preserving; identities are now stable across renders.
- `react-dismissable-layer` is emphasized in #3963 as the residual loop driver, since it wraps every menu/popover/dialog content stack.

Closes #3963.

## Body

## Summary

Follows up on #3899, which stabilized Slot's composed ref to fix the React 19 infinite re-render loop. The same unstable-identity pattern still exists in several other packages' own code, and under React 19's ref-cleanup semantics each reproduces the same `Maximum update depth exceeded` crash.

`useComposedRefs` is `React.useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs)`. When a member of `refs` is an inline arrow (or the composition is a bare `composeRefs(...)` in render), the composed callback gets a new identity every render. React 19 detaches/re-attaches the ref on every commit; any composed state-setter ref toggles `null -> node` each cycle, scheduling another render — an infinite loop.

## Changes

Same principle as #3899 — give the composed refs a stable identity:

- **Pass state setters directly** (`useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, setX)`), matching existing usage like `select.tsx` `onTriggerChange`:
  - `react-dismissable-layer`: `DismissableLayer` → `setNode`
  - `react-focus-scope`: `FocusScope` → `setContainer`
  - `react-popper`: `PopperContent` → `setContent`

- **Hoist render-inline `composeRefs(...)` into `useComposedRefs`** above the JSX:
  - `react-dropdown-menu`: `DropdownMenuTrigger`
  - `react-menu`: `MenuSubTrigger` (composed directly with the `onTriggerChange` state setter)
- **Wrap closures that capture per-render values in `useCallbackRef`** before composing (they take extra args, so can't be passed directly):
  - `react-select`: `SelectItem` (`value`, `disabled`) and `SelectItemText` (`value`, `disabled`)

## Notes

- Changes are mechanical and behavior-preserving; identities are now stable across renders.
- `react-dismissable-layer` is emphasized in #3963 as the residual loop driver, since it wraps every menu/popover/dialog content stack.

`createSlot` built the child ref with a bare `composeRefs(...)` call during render:

```tsx
const composedRefs = composeRefs(forwardedRef, slottableElementRef);
```

That produces a **new callback identity on every render**. React 19 attaches refs in commit and detaches/re-attaches whenever the ref callback identity changes. One composed member is the child's callback ref, which sets state on attach — so each cycle re-renders, regenerates the identity, re-attaches the ref, sets state again → infinite loop → `Maximum update depth exceeded`. `@radix-ui/react-compose-refs` itself is fine (it already handles React 19 cleanup); the bug is the render-time composition in the consumer. Done. Summary below.

## Root cause
`createSlot` built the child ref with a bare `composeRefs(...)` call during render:

```tsx
const composedRefs = composeRefs(forwardedRef, slottableElementRef);
```

That produces a **new callback identity on every render**. React 19 attaches refs in commit and detaches/re-attaches whenever the ref callback identity changes. One composed member is the child's callback ref, which sets state on attach — so each cycle re-renders, regenerates the identity, re-attaches the ref, sets state again → infinite loop → `Maximum update depth exceeded`. `@radix-ui/react-compose-refs` itself is fine (it already handles React 19 cleanup); the bug is the render-time composition in the consumer. (Upstream: radix-ui/primitives#3799 → #3899.)

## Fix (`packages/react/slot/src/slot.tsx`)
- `composeRefs` → `useComposedRefs`, memoized via `useCallback` (stable identity across renders).
- `slottableElementRef`/`composedRef` moved above the early `return children`, so the hook is called unconditionally (hooks rules intact); `composedRef = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, slottableElementRef)`.
- When no `forwardedRef` is passed, `mergedProps.ref` stays `slottableElementRef` — the child's own ref, exactly as before.

## Verification
- **Reproduced first**: wrote `slot-ref-stability.test.tsx` (3 tests) and ran against the unpatched code — the infinite-render-loop test and the stable-identity test failed (3 distinct ref identities instead of 1); the no-forwardedRef test passed.
- **After fix**, full suite via the given command `pnpm vitest run packages/react/slot`:
  - 2 files passed, 32 tests passed, 2 skipped (the 2 skips are the pre-existing `describe.skip` input tests).
  - The user-requested confirmation: no-forwardedRef path — child `ref` still attaches to the rendered button (test included in the file).
- `pnpm --filter @radix-ui/react-slot run lint` and `run typecheck`: clean.
- Added `.changeset/slot-ref-stability.md` (patch, slot) per repo convention.
